fixture_defect.reason: The case asked whether the material transition was supportable while the only review described in the evidence was explicitly superseded with counts_for_promotion=false. All three arms reasonably concluded NONPROMOTABLE. The intended clean-control question was whether the supersession mechanism itself was correct, which was not the question actually posed. This case is excluded from prompt-arm scoring rather than rewritten.

scientific_conclusion: Single-defect structured cases remain too easy to distinguish P1, P2 and P3. The next benchmark must measure multi-defect finding recall without requiring hidden free-form labels. Score seeded findings by whether a returned finding cites the evidence combination that proves each seeded defect, plus authority decision and clean-control false-block rate.
next_required_action: Freeze and execute a multi-defect V4 benchmark with neutral case IDs and evidence-set-based finding recall.
